selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Who can learn from the Qur'an in this passage?
questions.answer: All kinds of people can learn from it.

questions.question: What do many different scholars get from the Qur'an?
questions.answer: They get what they need for their fields of study.

questions.question: What does this show about the Qur'an?
questions.answer: It shows that it is full of truth and real guidance.

questions.question: Which group was very strong in language and writing?
questions.answer: Arab literary experts were.

questions.question: What did those non-Muslim experts fail to make, even in a very small amount?
questions.answer: They could not make anything equal to even one surah.

questions.question: What does their failure help prove?
questions.answer: It helps prove that the Qur'an is beyond human power.

questions.question: Why is it important that even smart people stayed unable to answer its challenge?
questions.answer: It shows its miracle is too great for people to match.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The Qur'an teaches everyone and cannot be copied by people.

questions.question: Do only highly educated people benefit from the Qur'an in this passage, or many levels of people?
questions.answer: Many levels of people benefit from it.

questions.question: What kinds of school subjects or sciences are said to take answers from the Qur'an?
questions.answer: Many Islamic sciences and branches of knowledge do.

questions.question: How do religion scholars use the Qur'an?
questions.answer: They take answers and needed knowledge from it.

questions.question: What does that tell us about the Qur'an as a source?
questions.answer: It is a source of truth and reality.

questions.question: Who most needed to challenge the Qur'an with strong language?
questions.answer: Non-Muslim Arab masters of language did.

questions.question: Were they able to bring something equal to one surah, or not?
questions.answer: They were not able to do that.

questions.question: What happened to later speakers and scholars who wanted fame by arguing against it?
questions.answer: They could not defeat it and had to stay quiet.

questions.question: What two big qualities of the Qur'an are highlighted in this passage?
questions.answer: Its deep guidance and its miraculous speech.

questions.question: What does the passage say about simple people and very smart people with the Qur'an?
questions.answer: Both can receive their share from it.

questions.question: Can people understand only easy ideas from it, or also very deep truths?
questions.answer: They can understand very deep truths too.

questions.question: What do great scholars of Islamic law do with the Qur'an?
questions.answer: They draw out teachings and answers from it.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention many kinds of scholars?
questions.answer: To show the Qur'an helps in many areas of knowledge.

questions.question: Which people were known as the top experts in literature at that time?
questions.answer: Arab literary figures were.

questions.question: What is one part of the Qur'an’s miracle named in the passage?
questions.answer: Its beautiful and powerful language.

questions.question: If no one could match even one part of it, what can we infer?
questions.answer: Its words are not like normal human words.

questions.question: Put the main message in one short sentence.
questions.answer: The Qur'an guides all people and no person can make anything like it.
